<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def hull(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    ys = [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(rows) for j,c in enumerate(r) if c=='Y']
    return ys
print('before', hull(current_frame))
r1 = action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
print('after 3xRIGHT', hull(current_frame), {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
r2 = action(['ACTION7'])
print('after ACTION7', hull(current_frame), {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
p = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diff = [(i,j,p[i][j],c[i][j]) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if p[i][j]!=c[i][j]]
print('diff n', len(diff), diff[:40])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
